task: World +45 degrees. Both arms use the augmented 18-action 191-observation native task, nominal training resets, proximity and sustained dwell reward. Fixed: same robot with forearm drive commanding zero and mechanical stops at zero. All original finger and wrist joints active. Free: existing +/-60 deg roll. Both train from scratch and use only the final checkpoint.
test: Identical new perturbed cube quaternions across conditions and seeds, XYZ half-ranges 5/10/10 degrees. Drop absorbing. Primary ever completed 16 consecutive live samples below 0.1 rad. Secondary ever entered, final 16, drop. Report conditional conversion and per-seed paired gains/losses.
mechanism: World cube and initial-palm relative net orientations at first completed hold. Split world-axis projected incremental rotation vectors into tower, palm minus tower, and cube minus palm; signed contributions telescope to projected cube rotation. Also compare paired cases at 1 s and compare free-only rescues at the free first-hold time while both are alive. Separately report rotated-with-palm and in-hand-only counterfactual target errors. The split is kinematic, not contact force attribution.
